title: Building VedOS Academy, an AI-powered learning platform inspired by games. Looking for early testers and educators.
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to share an early look at VedOS Academy. We’re building it for people who want more say in what they learn, how they learn it, and how fast they move.

You start with your own room. It’s your learning space, where you can use AI to turn something you’re curious about into a course and build a curriculum around your interests. For example, if you want to learn photography, you could ask AI to help you put together a course that starts with phone photography and gives you a hands-on challenge after each lesson. You can decide what to focus on, revisit anything you want to practise, and work through lessons and challenges at your own pace, like progressing through a game.

AI also helps while you’re learning. If you get stuck, you can ask for a hint, a different explanation, or another example and then get back to the challenge.

We’re also building a Creator Room for teachers, professors, and creators who want to turn what they teach into game-based courses for others. I’d love to collaborate with people who want to try that with a subject they already teach. We have so many more features planned out for the future.

This is an early prototype. Access is through a waitlist while we build the core experience. We’re looking for early testers who’ll tell us what works, what’s confusing, and what they’d actually come back to use.

But primarily we are looking for teachers and educators who make online courses for websites like Udemy. Collaborate with them and convert their courses into playable experiences.

Here is the link: [https://vedosacademy.mythicmotion.in/](https://vedosacademy.mythicmotion.in/)

If you’d like to test it or build a course with us, drop a comment or send me a message.
